text:
Type: house-shaped soft cushion
Use: play, cuddling and decoration on a bed or a floor; children's room, playroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: printed cotton fabric, soft polyester filling
Colors: bright red, black and white stripes, sky blue, sunny yellow, grey
Shape: little house outline with a striped roof, grey chimney, printed window with curtains and a blue door, plump and rounded, small
Feel: playful, cheerful, cozy, bright
Goes with: primary colors, white furniture, light wood; colorful children's rooms and playrooms

product.name: HEMMAHOS
product.description: A house with its own chimney and everything! Just big enough to fit in the bed, and nice and soft against your childs cheek.
